rationale: The event trace satisfies both hard constraints: (1) The resource remains connected throughout and all voltage/time points stay within the ride-through envelope (0.55 pu at t=0.05-0.12s is within the 0.2 pu minimum for ≤0.15s; 0.9 pu at t=0.55s is within the 0.5 pu minimum for ≤0.7s). (2) Reactive current support meets the requirement: voltage drops below 0.9 pu at t=0.05s, and by t=0.12s (within the 0.1s response deadline), iq_pu=0.25 exceeds the minimum of 0.2 pu. All compliance checks pass.
